plan.question_frame: Safety/PECO assessment as of 2024-12-31: among adults with rheumatoid arthritis receiving marketed tofacitinib, with explicit separation of the ORAL Surveillance risk-enriched population aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor, compare tofacitinib 5 mg or 10 mg twice daily with tumor necrosis factor inhibitors and assess major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy, venous and arterial thrombosis including pulmonary embolism, and all-cause mortality; link the pivotal postauthorization study across NCT02092467/A3921133, its primary publication, and dated FDA actions, then seek qualifying or conflicting evidence and publication corrections or retractions that alter evidence handling.
stop_rules: Run no more than 16 query events and preserve each exact query, route, wave, execution timestamp, requested cutoff, result count, and provider version when available.
Complete all three selected source routes and reconcile source_map against the routes actually used by the queries.

Recover the NCT02092467/A3921133 registry anchor, the exact primary ORAL Surveillance publication, the 2019 FDA thrombosis action, and the 2021 FDA safety-action sequence; if any anchor remains missing after its confirmation query, stop escalation at the query cap and report it as a gap.
Complete a distinct challenge search for each high-impact claim family: cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, and publication correction or retraction status.
Stop study-family expansion after two consecutive screened result batches add no new decision-relevant study, outcome qualification, publication-integrity notice, or identifier linkage.
Stop outcome retrieval only after each of the four safety domains has either direct comparative evidence plus a qualifying or conflicting evidence check, or an explicit documented no-evidence result.

Stop regulatory retrieval after FDA actions and current labeling implications are chronologically reconciled through 2024-12-31, including jurisdiction, action date, affected dose or population, and cited evidentiary basis.

Apply publication cutoffs after retrieval when indexing syntax is ambiguous, and stop with temporal status unresolved when online-first, issue, registry-update, or FDA effective dates cannot be adjudicated without an unavailable source.

Merge records by PMID, DOI, NCT number, sponsor study ID, and FDA document identity while preserving all query-to-record links; fail closed and stop synthesis for conflicting duplicate identities until adjudicated.

Declare the plan complete when all anchors, outcome branches, integrity checks, source-route checks, and temporal checks are resolved or when the 16-event budget is exhausted with every unresolved item listed in coverage_gaps.
